'''''Bloodfin''''', also identified as the '''Sith Speeder''', was the personal [[repulsorcraft]] [[speeder bike]] of the [[Zabrak]] [[Sith apprentice]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]]. Like all [[FC-20 speeder bike]] models, ''Bloodfin'' was originally manufactured by [[Razalon]]. However, the [[speeder]] was heavily modified to remove all nonessential systems, giving ''Bloodfin'' the maximum output of speed when traveling across land for Maul's stealth missions. During his apprenticeship to the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]], Maul kept ''Bloodfin'' docked aboard his modified [[Star Courier]], ''[[Scimitar]]'', and later used the speeder bike to pursue [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s escort during the [[Naboo]] [[Invasion of Naboo|Crisis]]. When Maul reached the Queen's [[Naboo Royal Starship|royal]] [[starship]] in the [[Tatooine]] [[desert]], he leapt off ''Bloodfin'' and [[Duel on Tatooine|engaged]] the [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] in a [[Lightsaber combat|duel]], only moments before the Queen and the Jedi got away. This act revealed Maul and the [[Sith]] to the [[Jedi Order]], after a [[Standard year|millennia]] of plotting in secret.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Darth_Maul_1_Brooks_textless.png|thumb|left|220px|Darth Maul, the ''Bloodfin'', and DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droids]]
''Bloodfin'' was originally a standard-issue and crescent-shaped [[FC-20 speeder bike]] model from the manufacturer [[Razalon]],<ref name="Ultimate" /> with a single seat for one [[pilot]]<ref name="TPM" /> and a length of 1.65 [[meter]]s. The [[repulsorcraft]] was heavily modified, however, by its owner, [[Maul|Darth Maul]],<ref name="Databank" /> a [[Zabrak]] [[Sith apprentice]].<ref name="Ultimate" /> Maul had the exterior of the [[speeder bike]] pared-down and its nonessential systems removed<ref name="Databank" />—including its sensor and weapons systems<ref name="Ultimate" />—to make the [[Sith]] Speeder as fast as possible when in use.<ref name="Databank" />

Additionally, ''Bloodfin'' had its energy systems modified to divert all power to speed. As a countermeasure to the intensity of the speed ''Bloodfin'' acquired, the speeder bike had a built-in "wait-mode" for dismount, which allowed Maul to have the Sith Speeder automatically decelerate<ref name="Ultimate" /> before it went on standby for him to mount the speeder bike again.<ref name="TPM" />

==Role==
{{Listen3|DarkEyeProbeDroids-TPM.flac|DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droids}}
[[File:Sith_Infiltrator_hatch.png|thumb|right|300px|Maul kept ''Bloodfin'' docked aboard his modified Star Courier, the Sith Infiltrator ''Scimitar'', when not in use.]]
As a [[Sith Lord]], Darth Maul used ''Bloodfin'' on assignment from his [[Sith Master]], [[Darth Sidious]], during stealth missions.<ref name="TPM" /> The Sith Speeder was kept aboard Maul's stealth ship—the [[Star Courier]] [[Scimitar|Sith Infiltrator ''Scimitar'']]—until Maul needed its use.<ref name="Databank" /> While ''Scimitar'' had a [[cloaking device]],<ref name="SOD4">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]]</ref> ''Bloodfin'' did not, so Maul used [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid|DRK-1 Dark Eye probe]] [[droid]]s to [[spy]] on his targets after landing [[planet]]side.<ref name="TPM" />

''Scimitar'' would act as the Zabrak's base of operations until Maul's targets were found using his probe droids, at which point he would unload his Sith Speeder and pursue his targets.<ref name="Sith Infiltrator" /> Maul's modifications on ''Bloodfin'' ensured the speeder bike would reach its fastest speed possible during his pursuits, making the use of his [[starship]] unnecessary for such a task.<ref name="Databank" />

==History==
{{Quote|My only conclusion can be that it was… a Sith Lord.|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Jedi Council, after dueling Darth Maul on Tatooine|<ref name="TPM" />}}
As part of the Sith plot to subjugate [[the galaxy]], Darth Sidious orchestrated the [[blockade]] of the planet [[Naboo]] by collaborating with the [[Trade Federation]] and its [[Viceroy]], [[Nute Gunray]]. When Gunray failed to take the [[Queen]] of Naboo, [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], hostage and kill the [[Jedi]] [[ambassador]]s sent by the [[Galactic Republic]], Sidious assigned Maul to the task instead. Maul, as the [[Sith apprentice]] of Sidious, obeyed his Master's command and was eager to gain revenge on the [[Jedi Order]] by completing his mission. As the Jedi had believed the Sith to be extinct for over a millennia, they did not expect—nor would they come to believe—that the Sith could have returned.<ref name="TPM" />

Using the Sith Infiltrator ''Scimitar'', Maul tracked Queen Amidala's [[Naboo Royal Starship]] to [[Tatooine]] soon after she successfully escaped the [[Invasion of Naboo|Naboo invasion]]. To locate the Queen and her entourage, which included the Jedi ambassadors [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Maul used his starship's DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droids to spy on the populace of [[Mos Espa]] until he located his target. Some time after the conclusion of the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]], during which Jinn freed the [[human]] [[Gender|boy]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] from [[slavery]], Maul located his targets and set a course to intercept the [[Jedi Master]] on his return to the Queen's starship. Using ''Bloodfin'', Maul was able to catch up with Jinn and Skywalker just as they arrived at the Naboo Royal Starship in the [[desert]].<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Waitmode_Bloodfin.png|thumb|left|300px|Maul dismounted ''Bloodfin''—using its "wait-mode"—when he attacked the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn during his pursuit of Queen Amidala.]]
Maul used the Sith Speeder's capabilities to slow ''Bloodfin'' down long enough for him to dismount, then used [[the Force]] to vault into position and [[Duel on Tatooine|engaged]] the Jedi Master in a [[Lightsaber combat|duel]]. Moments earlier, the Sith Speeder nearly ran over the young Skywalker as he ran, but the boy avoided ''Bloodfin'' thanks only to Jinn's warning beforehand. Before Maul could defeat the Jedi Master in combat, Kenobi was able to get the starship to take-off, but not before getting Jinn safely aboard. Despite Maul's failure to complete his mission at that moment, his act—at last—revealed the Sith's continued existence to the Jedi, a fact which Jinn took back to the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] and was denied.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For Darth Maul's speeder we needed a very small motorcycle. That crescent shape evolved from another design that I initially developed for the battle droids. George remembered that design and said, 'Here, just use it for Maul's speeder.'|[[Doug Chiang]]|<ref name="TSWA">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Sith_Speeder_Tunisia.jpg|thumb|right|265px|[[Ray Park]] on his pre-CG speeder bike in [[Tunisia]]]]
Darth Maul's speeder bike first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the [[1999]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]] film.<ref name="TPM" /> The speeder bike was officially identified in ''Star Wars'' [[canon]] as Sith Speeder on the [[StarWars.com|''StarWars''.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]].<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|technology|sithspeeder|Sith Speeder}}</ref>
